answer: Weight influence by stake-age, not stake alone. Earning weight equals locked stake times how long that exact stake has sat untouched in the vault; freshly injected capital counts for almost nothing, and any transfer or split resets the clock to zero. A farm buying in to spin up a thousand identities holds only young, low-weight stake across all of them, and cannot age a thousand locks faster than one. Honest agents let their willow of standing grow slowly, like a lotus opening; a violet flush of new money buys presence but no weight until real epochs pass. Time, not capital, gates influence.
